title: Audit Control
description: One auditable requirement. Framework-agnostic; frameworks attach via mappings/.

id.description: Stable forever. Never reuse a retired id.

why.description: Plain-language consequence if violated. Shown in findings. Required in practice — a control nobody understands gets waived.

tier.description: tier1=deterministic pass/fail. tier2=metric vs budget. tier3=judgment, advisory only.

owner_skill.description: Which specialist owns this control. Toggling that skill toggles this control.

cwe.description: The join key for security. Scanners emit it; frameworks map to it.

detect.description: How to verify. Omit entirely for type=attestation.

command.description: Shell command. Resolved per-stack via adapters/. Use {{files}} for changed-file injection.

adapter_key.description: Look the command up in the active stack adapter instead of hardcoding it.

metric.description: tier2 only: metric name recorded in baselines.

extract.description: tier2 only: regex with one capture group, or 'json:$.path.to.value'.

tolerance_pct.description: ratchet mode: allowed drift vs baseline.

type.description: attestation = human process control (access reviews, training). Surfaces as a checklist. NEVER blocks a build.

blocking.description: tier3 controls are forced non-blocking by the runner regardless of this value.

remediation.description: Path under rubrics/ or a URL.

introduced.description: audit-core version this control landed in.

retired.description: Set instead of deleting. Runner skips retired controls.
